name: horizon
description: Root test aggregator: farm/checks.py detects checks at the repo root only, so this script is what makes the server and ui suites (plus the infra/host/deploy-*.sh stubbed-PATH shell harness) run at the guardrail gate. The Python suite is wired via pytest.ini. test:e2e runs the Playwright suite (e2e/) end to end in demo mode — farm/checks.py detects and runs it separately, skipping with a warning on hosts without Chromium installed (npx --prefix e2e playwright install chromium, once). HZ-142: infra/whatsapp-bridge/run-checks.sh (gofmt + go vet + go test) is in the same list, because the WhatsApp bridge is a fork whose patch holds vote decryption, durability ordering and retry policy — out-of-repo Go would otherwise be gated by nothing; it skips with a warning on a host with no Go toolchain. HZ-128: `type: module` is here because domain/js/lifecycle.js is the only JavaScript at the repo root with no nearer package.json — without it Node reparses it as ESM and warns on every server/e2e test run. verify-base-build.mjs is what makes the production-base UI build a real gate check (infra/host/test/deploy.test.sh stubs npm, so it never runs a real vite build). HZ-328: tests:export-history, tests:inventory and tests:select build tests/inventory.csv, tests/coverage-map.json and tests/blocking.json (scripts/tests/select-blocking.mjs has the rule); no check runs them.

scripts.test: npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix ui install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix ui run test && bash infra/host/test/deploy.test.sh && bash infra/host/test/deploy-drain.test.sh && bash infra/host/test/deploy-drain-cancel.test.sh && bash infra/host/test/deploy-grpc-service.test.sh && bash infra/host/test/deploy-publish-release.test.sh && bash infra/host/test/deploy-code-only.test.sh && bash infra/whatsapp-bridge/run-checks.sh && node ui/scripts/verify-base-build.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix ui install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix e2e install --no-audit --no-fund && npx --prefix e2e playwright install chromium && npm --prefix e2e test
